```ruby title="Ruby"

result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<form><label for="name">Name:</label><input type="text" id="name" placeholder="Enter name"></form>', HtmlToMarkdownRs::ConversionOptions.new(preprocessing: { 'remove_forms' => false }))
```
